note: §10: requirements for any FUTURE capital-utility benchmark. No benchmark is created in this stage.

requirements.name: baseline neither floor nor ceiling
requirements.statement: the control arm must sit strictly between the worst and best attainable outcomes, with room to move in BOTH directions

requirements.name: multiple outcome dimensions have stochastic headroom
requirements.statement: at least two outcome dimensions must vary under repetition of the control, so one saturated dimension cannot carry the whole assay

requirements.name: at least one treatment-relevant failure class varies
requirements.statement: a failure class the candidate capital is ABOUT must vary across runs; variation in an unrelated class cannot measure the capital's utility

requirements.name: the candidate capital addresses an outcome that can vary
requirements.statement: the bundle's own recorded method must mechanically cover a case that varies; coverage of an INVARIANT case contributes nothing to a marginal estimate

requirements.name: success cannot hinge entirely on one unrelated residual case
requirements.statement: if all arm-level variation traces to a single case that no added capital addresses, the assay is not measuring the capital

evidence: every trial scored 13/14 or 14/14 — the baseline is at the ceiling (UQ-1)
13 of 14 hidden cases are invariant across all 20 candidates (UQ-2, UQ-3)
the one varying case (h14) is addressed directly only by D, which is in every arm, and only GENERICALLY by B and C (UQ-4)
all arm-level variation traces to that single unrelated residual case (UQ-5)
